nf1e9915e8e6.s: Which is the oldest UN agency, established in 1865?
nf1e9915e8e6.x: The ITU, founded in 1865, is the oldest UN agency; it has 194 members and is headquartered in Geneva, not London.

nd3629976727.s: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is a national of:
nd3629976727.x: Tedros is Ethiopian. Celeste Saulo is Argentine, Arsenio Dominguez Panamanian and Qu Dongyu Chinese.

n992f8a5cdab.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about criticisms of the WTO and the Bretton Woods institutions?
o: The WTO Appellate Body is paralysed.
India is blocking the Investment Facilitation for Development (IFD) agreement.
A voting imbalance continues in the Bretton Woods institutions.
The Bretton Woods institutions have abolished quota-based voting.
n992f8a5cdab.x: Quota-based voting has not been abolished; the criticism is a continuing voting imbalance. Appellate Body paralysis and India's blocking of IFD are correct.

nf11ec956293.s: Which country was the first in the Americas to eliminate leprosy?
nf11ec956293.x: WHO certified Chile as the first country in the Americas to eliminate leprosy.

n6c32ee644cd.s: In 2025, S&P upgraded India's sovereign rating from BBB- to:
n6c32ee644cd.x: S&P raised India from BBB- to BBB in 2025, its first upgrade in nearly two decades, and affirmed BBB in September 2026.

nfe590bb9340.x: The Minamata Convention concerns mercury, with dental amalgam to be phased out by 2034; POPs belong to the Stockholm Convention.

n06f207e8bf4.s: Which country became the first South Asian party to the UN Water Convention (Helsinki, 1992)?
n06f207e8bf4.x: Bangladesh became the first South Asian party to the Water Convention, which governs transboundary rivers and lakes.

n2d92c0cef5b.s: India's refusal to join which of the following has been defended as protecting its policy space?
o: The IFD initiative and the WHO Pandemic Agreement
The UN Cybercrime Convention and the WHO Pandemic Agreement
The IFD initiative and the UN Cybercrime Convention
n2d92c0cef5b.x: India's refusals on Investment Facilitation for Development and the Cybercrime Convention are defended as protecting policy space; the Pandemic Agreement is a separate matter.

nc2efe6f8849.s: Which country became NATO's 32nd member in 2024?
nc2efe6f8849.x: Sweden joined as the 32nd member in 2024; Finland had joined as the 31st in 2023.

n62bd9c03580.s: The India-EU FTA is to operate along with which agreements?
o: An Investment Protection Agreement and a GI Agreement
A GI Agreement and a Nuclear Liability Convention
An Investment Protection Agreement and a Nuclear Liability Convention
n62bd9c03580.x: The India-EU FTA ('Mother of All Deals') comes with an Investment Protection Agreement and a Geographical Indications Agreement; no nuclear liability convention accompanies it.

n7af1bd936bd.s: The five-year term of the next UN Secretary-General begins on:
n7af1bd936bd.x: Guterres demits office at the end of 2026 and his successor's term begins on 1 January 2027.

n51e1ae380db.s: In January 2026, the IMF raised India's 2025-26 growth projection to:
n51e1ae380db.x: The IMF's January 2026 WEO raised FY26 to 7.3% (from 6.6%); 6.2% was its April 2026 FY27 figure and 7.2% the World Bank's January figure.

ca959b1635fb97.s: Under the Lindsey O. Graham Act, 2026, tariffs of up to 100% may apply after 30 days to which importers of Russian energy?
ca959b1635fb97.x: The tariff is not automatic; it can hit only the top five importers of Russian energy (or top five sanction-evasion facilitators) after 30 days.

caf07fc1733a65.s: India and Vietnam have set a bilateral trade target of ____ by 2030.
caf07fc1733a65.x: The India-Vietnam target is USD 25 billion by 2030; USD 100 billion is the India-Russia target.

caffc3c6f5828c.s: India and Italy established a Strategic Partnership in:
caffc3c6f5828c.x: The India-Italy Strategic Partnership dates to 2023; diplomatic ties go back to 1947.

cada3587a6f9a5.s: Through which land port did India export about 500 tonnes of Hilsa to Bangladesh in 2026?
cada3587a6f9a5.x: About 500 tonnes moved through Petrapole Land Port, West Bengal, reversing the usual Bangladesh-to-India Hilsa trade.

cnff37aced780b.s: Which Talwar-class frigate represented India in Exercise Konkan-2026?
cnff37aced780b.x: INS Trishul, a Talwar-class frigate, took part in Konkan-2026; INS Sahyadri is Shivalik-class.

cnf61956b6a81b.s: The Czech Republic became independent on 1 January 1993 after the dissolution of:
cnf61956b6a81b.x: The Czech Republic became independent on 1 January 1993 when Czechoslovakia was dissolved.

cn3262f1407bd6.s: India and Canada established diplomatic relations in:
cn3262f1407bd6.x: India-Canada diplomatic relations date from 1947; Canada supplies uranium, pulses and farm products to India.

cnc1e1b6b341d7.s: Vladivostok, venue of the Harbour Phase of INDRA-2026, is the headquarters of Russia's:
cnc1e1b6b341d7.x: Vladivostok is the HQ of the Russian Pacific Fleet; INDRA-2026's Sea Phase was in the Sea of Japan.

cn937d2db518c0.s: Who unveiled 'Dewi', the AI digital ambassador of the Indian Embassy in Indonesia?
cn937d2db518c0.x: Ambassador Sandeep Chakravorty unveiled the AI avatar 'Dewi' in October 2026.

cn8e04f4ccfe45.s: AUSINDEX is an India-Australia exercise of which service?
cn8e04f4ccfe45.x: AUSINDEX is a naval exercise; AUSTRAHIND is the Army exercise and Pitch Black a multinational air exercise.

cn5aa8bb23de38.s: The Battle Axe Division, which conducted Akhand Prahar-II, is under which Command?
cn5aa8bb23de38.x: The Battle Axe Division is under Southern Command (HQ Pune), not South Western Command.

cn907768f6be1f.s: SIMBEX, India's longest-running uninterrupted bilateral naval exercise, began in 1994 as Exercise:
cn907768f6be1f.x: SIMBEX started in 1994 as Exercise Lion King.

cn9d8d0415949a.s: Greece's ban on social media for children under 15 comes into force on:
cn9d8d0415949a.x: The Greek Parliament passed the law on 23 October 2026; it comes into force on 1 January 2027, with no parental-consent exemption.

cn78cca9a52991.s: The US-Japan Treaty of Mutual Cooperation and Security was signed in:
cn78cca9a52991.x: The treaty was signed in 1960. Keen Sword, the US-Japan exercise, is biennial, not annual.

cn29623a379530.s: About what share of the procurement approved by the DAC on 26 October 2026 is to be sourced domestically?
cn29623a379530.x: About 82% of the ₹2.12 lakh crore package is to be made domestically.

cnd837168133dd.s: With India's support, the SAMHiTA project will digitise and preserve how many ancient manuscripts?
cnd837168133dd.x: SAMHiTA will digitise and preserve 100 ancient manuscripts. Sri Lanka's official capital is Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte; Colombo is the commercial capital.

cn0033d93a1722.s: Which unit represented India in Garuda Shakti 2026?
cn0033d93a1722.x: The Parachute Regiment (Special Forces) represented India; Samudra Shakti is the India-Indonesia naval exercise.

cnc518b2c61068.s: The Special Utility Helicopters approved for the IAF in October 2026 will replace the:
cnc518b2c61068.x: The 24 helicopters (about ₹10,000 crore) for VVIP transport will replace the Russian-origin Mi-17 V5.

cn3025061e73d2.s: India-South Korea ties were upgraded to a Special Strategic Partnership in:
cn3025061e73d2.x: The upgrade came in 2015. INS Sahyadri was commissioned on 21 July 2012, not 2010.

cn4dcba42232e8.s: Under the IG Defence–MSA Global MoU, 'BAJ' is a/an:
cn4dcba42232e8.x: BAJ is the unmanned aerial interceptor; KAL is the long-range strike UAS (1,000 km) and JWALA the counter-drone micro-missile.

cn68fb74915bd8.s: In the IAF's 'VAYU' vision, 'Y' stands for:
cn68fb74915bd8.x: In VAYU, Y = Yukti (innovation). The IAF was established on 8 October 1932.

cn9694514018b3.s: The UNGA declared 2 October the International Day of Non-Violence in:
cn9694514018b3.x: The UNGA declared the International Day of Non-Violence in 2007.

cn10fb410d990d.s: How many Next Generation Corvettes did the MoD contract for ₹53,866.50 crore on 2 November 2026?
cn10fb410d990d.x: The MoD signed contracts with GRSE and Goa Shipyard Ltd for eight Next Generation Corvettes.

cn06870d1c8b8c.s: How many of the eight Next Generation Corvettes will GRSE build?
cn06870d1c8b8c.x: GRSE will build five and Goa Shipyard Ltd (HQ Vasco da Gama) three. GRSE was set up in 1884.

cn1aa0b54dce1e.s: INS Sudarshini's Lokayan-26 voyage made 17 port calls in how many countries?
cn1aa0b54dce1e.x: Lokayan-26 made 17 port calls in 11 countries. INS Sudarshini was built by Goa Shipyard Ltd.

cn316e4244012e.s:
Assertion (A): Coast Guard Day is observed on 1 February.
Reason (R): The Indian Coast Guard was established on 1 February 1977.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
cn316e4244012e.x: Both are true and R explains A: Coast Guard Day marks the ICG's establishment on 1 February 1977 (it was formally inaugurated on 18 August 1978).

cn90d2c1b87264.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Project-18A Next Generation Destroyers?
o: They will be supervised by the Navy's Warship Design Bureau.
MDL and GRSE are the shipyards linked to the project.
Six Visakhapatnam-class (Project-15B) destroyers were built by MDL.
cn90d2c1b87264.x: Four, not six, Project-15B destroyers were built by MDL. The project costs about ₹80,000 crore and is supervised by the Warship Design Bureau with MDL and GRSE.

cnad9b09d4539f.s: Who represented India when Bhutan dedicated the 76th of 108 stupas to PM Modi?
cnad9b09d4539f.x: Kiren Rijiju represented India. Lhabab Duchen marks the Buddha's descent from Tavatimsa Heaven, not his enlightenment.

cn308d960eeaec.s: Which of the following 2026 exercises began first?
cn308d960eeaec.x: Mountain Guardian began on 5 October, Konkan on 8 October, INDRA on 13 October and Garuda Shakti on 27 October 2026.

caea1bd597f3b5.s: India and Mauritius concluded a 5-year petroleum product supply contract in August 2026 with which company?
caea1bd597f3b5.x: A G2G MoU on oil and gas and a 5-year petroleum supply contract with IOCL support Mauritius' energy security.

ca8869d43fb3d3.s: The LHB coaches that India supplies to Bangladesh Railway are of a design that originated in:
ca8869d43fb3d3.x: The LHB design is German. Exports resumed after about 10 years, not five.

ca810750cc034c.s: Who was elected the 23rd President of Bangladesh on 20 August 2026?
ca810750cc034c.x: BNP's Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir won with 255 votes in the first contested presidential election in 35 years; Tarique Rahman is PM.

caed5b9d0f3f54.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India–New Zealand relations?
o: The Roadmap seeks to double trade to NZ$7 billion by 2030.
The Roadmap to 2030 established diplomatic relations for the first time.
caed5b9d0f3f54.x: Diplomatic relations date from 1952, so the Roadmap to 2030 did not establish them; it is non-binding and targets NZ$7 billion by 2030.

ca9e5eb06d1df1.s: India and Indonesia will jointly develop which deep sea port near the Malacca Strait?
ca9e5eb06d1df1.x: Sabang Deep Sea Port, near the Malacca Strait, is to be developed jointly by India and Indonesia.

cafc8b25267e92.s: Bharat Dynamics Limited is headquartered at:
cafc8b25267e92.x: BDL is headquartered in Hyderabad; Gurugram hosts the IFC-IOR.

ca415ef34c1c41.s: The India–Japan Act East Forum was set up, and the Quad revived, in:
ca415ef34c1c41.x: 2017 saw the Act East Forum and the Quad's revival; 2014 was the Special Strategic and Global Partnership.

cab698f7548c34.s: PM Modi's 2026 Seychelles visit, hosted by President Patrick Herminie, produced how many outcomes?
cab698f7548c34.x: The visit for Seychelles' 50th National Day produced 19 outcomes.

ca4d2db4c77250.s: Which of the following is true of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement?
o: It includes a confirmed Pakistani nuclear guarantee.
It makes the three parties members of NATO.
Its full text and operational obligations are not public.
ca4d2db4c77250.x: The pact is not NATO, its text and duties are not public, and there is no confirmed Pakistani nuclear guarantee.

cabf6ecdd8b2c2.s: In 2026, which country sought compensation from South Africa for xenophobic violence?
cabf6ecdd8b2c2.x: Ghana is seeking compensation from South Africa, not the reverse.

caf357ef7ccb83.s: The India–Japan Cooperative Biogas for Growth Initiative supports India's target of how many biogas and organic fertiliser plants?
caf357ef7ccb83.x: The target is 1,000 biogas and organic fertiliser plants.

cac428a1de4d2d.s: UNICORN, the first India–Japan defence co-development programme, is a:
cac428a1de4d2d.x: UNICORN (Unified Complex Radio Antenna) is a naval stealth mast, the first India–Japan co-development programme.

ca7e6440d7235b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 16th India–Japan Annual Summit?
o: The summit date in the outcomes was 2 July 2026.
About 100 business cooperation agreements were signed.
Japan set a target of ¥10 trillion investment over the next decade.
It was held in New Delhi.
ca7e6440d7235b.x: About 120, not 100, business agreements were signed; the other statements are correct.

ca68effe8bbd77.s: About what share of India's LNG imports passes through the Strait of Hormuz?
ca68effe8bbd77.x: About 60% of LNG imports pass through Hormuz; crude is about 40% and LPG about 90%.

ca59b8f588a2af.s: Who was sworn in as President of Hungary on 19 August 2026?
ca59b8f588a2af.x: Former Supreme Court judge András Baka became President; Péter Magyar is Hungary's PM.

cabdc4d6c20ca6.s: What is the capital of Tanzania?
cabdc4d6c20ca6.x: Tanzania's capital is Dodoma, not Dar es Salaam.

ca63739c97a748.s: Lipulekh Pass is used for the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra and for trade between India and:
ca63739c97a748.x: Lipulekh is an India–China trade route and a Kailash Mansarovar Yatra route, not an India–Nepal trade route.

ca272341cc8a36.s: The delayed India–Nepal Pancheshwar project has a capacity of:
ca272341cc8a36.x: Pancheshwar is 5,040 MW; 10,000 MW is Nepal's planned hydropower export to India in a decade.

n61eebbf14ef.s: The India–Myanmar–Thailand Trilateral Highway is about how long?
n61eebbf14ef.x: The Trilateral Highway is 1,360 km; 1,643 km is the India–Myanmar border.

nf8999334c9d.s: India and Tanzania became strategic partners in:
nf8999334c9d.x: India and Tanzania set up a strategic partnership in 2023; IIT Madras Zanzibar is India's first overseas IIT.

ca7c83cb78a2af.s: India's LHB coach supply to Bangladesh is part of a 2024 contract for how many coaches?
ca7c83cb78a2af.x: The 2024 contract covers 200 coaches in 7 variants; the first rake had 19 coaches.

caab58d8ad2d9d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the August 2026 renaming of Lake Ontario?
o: The new name applies only to US federal use.
Canada also adopted the name Lake America.
The Gulf of Mexico had earlier been renamed the Gulf of America.
Lake Michigan is the only Great Lake wholly within the US.
caab58d8ad2d9d.x: Canada kept the name Lake Ontario; the order applies only to US federal use.

new.s: Deepavali was inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list in December 2025 as India's:
new.x: Deepavali became India's 16th ICH element on 10 December 2025; 45 is Sarnath's World Heritage number.

new.s: The 20th session of UNESCO's Intergovernmental Committee on Intangible Heritage (December 2025) was held at:
new.x: The 20th session met at the Red Fort, New Delhi (8-13 December 2025), the first time India hosted it.

new.s: Which Indian city joined the UNESCO Creative Cities Network for Gastronomy in 2025?
new.x: Lucknow joined in 2025 as India's second Gastronomy city; Hyderabad was the first, in 2019.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (UNESCO Creative City – field) is correctly matched?
new.x: Kozhikode is a City of Literature (2023). Gwalior is Music, Mumbai Film and Srinagar Crafts and Folk Arts.

new.s: The Exploration Museum with an Astronaut Monument honouring Apollo astronauts is at:
new.x: The Exploration Museum at Húsavík, Iceland, tells the history of exploration; its Astronaut Monument (2015) honours 32 Apollo astronauts.

new.s: The Apollo astronauts honoured at Húsavík did geology training in Iceland in:
new.x: The 32 Apollo astronauts trained in geology in Iceland in 1965 and 1967.

new.s: UNMISS is the UN peacekeeping mission in:
new.x: UNMISS is in South Sudan; MONUSCO is in DR Congo, UNIFIL in Lebanon and MINURSO in Western Sahara.

new.s: Which UN peacekeeping mission is the referendum mission in Western Sahara?
new.x: MINURSO is the Western Sahara referendum mission; UNDOF is on the Golan Heights and UNFICYP in Cyprus.

new.s: Which UN peacekeeping mission ended after the host country withdrew consent in June 2023?
new.x: MINUSMA is no longer active because Mali withdrew consent in June 2023.

new.s: Which country first explicitly guaranteed the freedom to have an abortion in its Constitution, in 2024?
new.x: France did so through a joint Congress at Versailles on 4 March 2024, by a vote of 780-72.

new.s: France's constitutional guarantee of abortion freedom was approved by a joint Congress at Versailles in:
new.x: The joint Congress at Versailles approved it on 4 March 2024 (780-72).

new.s: Khaled El-Enany, who became UNESCO Director-General in November 2025, is from:
new.x: El-Enany, an Egyptian Egyptologist, is UNESCO's first Arab head; he succeeded Audrey Azoulay of France.

new.s: Khaled El-Enany was elected UNESCO Director-General by the 43rd General Conference held at:
new.x: He was elected on 6 November 2025 by the 43rd General Conference at Samarkand, Uzbekistan.

new.s: Gilbert F. Houngbo, Director-General of the ILO, is a national of:
new.x: The ILO head Houngbo is from Togo, not Ghana.

new.s: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala, Director-General of the WTO, is from:
new.x: The WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala is Nigerian.

new.s: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva is a national of:
new.x: Georgieva is Bulgarian; Rebeca Grynspan (UNCTAD) is from Costa Rica and Grossi and Saulo are Argentine.

new.s: Which UN agency is headquartered in London?
new.x: IMO is in London; ITU and WMO are in Geneva and ICAO in Montreal.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about UNESCO?
o: It has 194 members and 12 associate members.
Khaled El-Enany succeeded Audrey Azoulay as its head.
new.x: UNESCO's Executive Board has 58 members; the 36-member Council belongs to ICAO.

new.s: After the 2010 reforms, India's voting share in the IMF is about:
new.x: India's IMF voting share is about 2.63%; its quota share is about 2.75%.

new.s: Which IMF reserve asset is called 'paper gold'?
new.x: The SDR, valued on a basket of five currencies, is known as 'paper gold'.

new.s: Which IMF facility gives quick liquidity without a full programme for disasters, pandemics or post-conflict needs?
new.x: The Rapid Financing Instrument provides quick liquidity without a full programme; the CRA is a BRICS arrangement.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the New Development Bank:
1. It was set up under the Fortaleza Declaration of 2014.
2. It is headquartered in Shanghai.
3. Its founder members each hold a veto.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The NDB gives no country a veto; the founders' vote only cannot fall below 55%.

new.s: The Mission Schools of Excellence, financed by the AIIB and the World Bank, are in:
new.x: AIIB and the World Bank fund Gujarat's ₹7,500-crore Mission Schools of Excellence.

new.s: In the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index 2023, India ranked:
new.x: India was 38th of 139 countries in the LPI 2023.

new.s: The World Economic Outlook is published by the:
new.x: WEO is the IMF's report; Global Economic Prospects is the World Bank's and the World Investment Report UNCTAD's.

new.s: According to the WTO, in 2024 India was the world's ____ largest exporter of commercial services.
new.x: India was the 8th-largest exporter (4.3%) and 9th-largest importer (3.4%) of commercial services in 2024.

new.s: The WTO's 14th Ministerial Conference (March 2026) was held at:
new.x: MC14 met at Yaoundé, Cameroon, on 26-29 March 2026 and ended in deadlock.

new.s: The Dunkel Draft (1991) was put forward during which GATT round?
new.x: GATT Director-General Arthur Dunkel's proposals came during the Uruguay Round.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Uruguay Round:
1. It was the 8th GATT round.
2. The Marrakesh Agreement was signed on 1 January 1995.
3. It concluded on 15 December 1993.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. The Marrakesh Agreement was signed on 15 April 1994; 1 January 1995 is when the WTO came into being.

new.s: Which pair (India's trade agreement – partner) is correctly matched?
new.x: The ECTA is with Australia. TEPA is with EFTA, CETA with the UK and the 2022 CEPA with the UAE.

new.s: Which country became the 21st member of the Eurozone?
new.x: Bulgaria became the Eurozone's 21st member.

new.s: What is India's status in APEC?
new.x: APEC has 21 economies and its Secretariat in Singapore; India is not a member, only an observer.

new.s: The African Union became a member of the G20 in:
new.x: The G20 has 19 countries, the EU and the African Union, which joined in 2023.

new.s: Which country joined BRICS in January 2025?
new.x: Indonesia joined in January 2025. Egypt joined in 2024, Argentina declined and Saudi Arabia has not formally joined.

new.s: The Windsor Framework (2023) concerns:
o: UK-EU post-Brexit trade rules for Northern Ireland
new.x: The Windsor Framework sets UK-EU post-Brexit trade rules for Northern Ireland.

new.s: Which instrument on ozone-depleting substances has been universally ratified by 197 parties?
new.x: The Montreal Protocol (1987) is universally ratified (197); Stockholm covers POPs, Rotterdam prior informed consent and Basel hazardous waste.

new.s: The Rotterdam Convention deals with:
o: Prior informed consent for hazardous chemicals
new.x: Rotterdam = prior informed consent; Stockholm = POPs; Minamata = mercury; Vienna/Montreal = ozone.

new.s: The Apostille Convention (1961) is one of the conventions of the:
o: Hague Conference on Private International Law
new.x: The Hague Conventions (HCCH) cover private international law, including the Apostille (1961) and Child Abduction (1980) conventions.

new.s: What is India's status on the BBNJ (High Seas) Treaty?
new.x: India has signed but not ratified the BBNJ Treaty, which entered into force on 17 January 2026.

new.s: In October 2025, Fiji became the 26th country to eliminate:
new.x: Fiji was certified the 26th country to eliminate trachoma, its first NTD eliminated.

new.s: Which country became the first in Africa to end onchocerciasis (river blindness)?
new.x: Niger became the first in Africa and fifth in the world to end onchocerciasis, in late 2025.

new.s: Which country was most recently certified malaria-free by WHO, in July 2025?
new.x: Timor-Leste was certified malaria-free in July 2025; Cabo Verde in 2024 and Sri Lanka in 2016.

new.s: Wild poliovirus is now endemic only in:
new.x: Wild poliovirus is endemic only in Pakistan and Afghanistan; India was certified polio-free in 2014.

new.s: The still-unfinished annex of the WHO Pandemic Agreement deals with:
new.x: The PABS (Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing) annex is unfinished; talks resumed in Geneva in July 2026.

new.s: The Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI) is headquartered in:
new.x: CDRI, launched by India in 2019, is headquartered in New Delhi, not Tokyo; Gurugram hosts the ISA.

new.s: The U.S.-led 'Pax Silica', which India joined in February 2026, concerns:
o: Maritime security in the Indian Ocean
Critical minerals, semiconductor and AI supply chains
new.x: Pax Silica covers critical minerals, semiconductor and AI supply chains; energy resilience is the aim of Japan's POWERR Asia.

new.s: POWERR Asia, launched under AZEC Plus in April 2026, is an initiative of:
new.x: POWERR Asia is Japan's initiative under AZEC Plus for energy resilience; India is a participant.

new.s: In India, which agency serves as the INTERPOL National Central Bureau?
new.x: The CBI is India's INTERPOL National Central Bureau and seeks Red Notices.

new.s: India was re-elected to the UNESCO Executive Board in December 2025 for the term:
new.x: India was re-elected to the UNESCO Executive Board for 2025-29; 2025-28 is its ICAO Council term and 2026-28 its UNHRC term.

new.s: The Kimberley Process, chaired by India in 2026, has how many participants?
new.x: The Kimberley Process has 60 participants: 59 countries plus the EU.

new.s: A candidate for UN Secretary-General needs how many 'encourage' votes in the UNSC, with no P5 veto?
new.x: A candidate needs 9 'encourage' votes and no veto from a permanent member.

new.s: SAGAR, India's maritime doctrine for the Indian Ocean neighbourhood, was announced in:
new.x: PM Modi announced SAGAR in 2015; MAHASAGAR followed in March 2025.

new.s: MAHASAGAR, which extends SAGAR to the Global South, was announced in March 2025 in:
new.x: MAHASAGAR (Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions) was announced in Mauritius in March 2025.

new.s: India's Act East Policy was announced in 2014 at the East Asia Summit held in:
new.x: Act East, an upgrade of Look East, was announced at the 2014 East Asia Summit in Nay Pyi Taw.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about India's nuclear doctrine:
1. The Executive Council of the Nuclear Command Authority is chaired by the PM.
2. It was adopted on 4 January 2003 by the Cabinet Committee on Security.
3. It follows a No First Use policy.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. The PM chairs the Political Council; the Executive Council is chaired by the NSA.

new.s: The I2U2 grouping consists of India, Israel, the US and:
new.x: I2U2 = India, Israel, UAE and US, launched in July 2022 and called the 'West Asian Quad'.

new.s: The I2U2 grouping, launched in July 2022, focuses on:
new.x: I2U2 focuses on food security and clean energy.

new.s: Hambantota port, leased for 99 years to China Merchants Port Holdings in 2017, is in:
new.x: Hambantota in Sri Lanka was leased for 99 years (70% stake) to China Merchants Port Holdings in 2017.

new.s: Which pair (port – host country) is correctly matched?
new.x: Gwadar (Pakistan) is the centrepiece of CPEC. Chabahar is in Iran, Sohar in Oman and Hambantota in Sri Lanka.

new.s: The 720 MW Mangdechhu Hydroelectric Project, built with Indian assistance, is in:
